description: Get daily performance metrics for a specific paid campaign. Use after nevent_list_paid_campaigns to get a valid campaignId. Date range defaults to the last 7 days when from/to are omitted. Returns daily rows with: spend, impressions, reach, frequency, clicks, CTR, CPM, CPC, ROAS, engagement rate, video metrics. Each row.date is an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. "2026-05-10T00:00:00Z"). A 404 may mean this tenant is not enrolled in the insights pilot — call nevent_paid_ads_health to confirm.

campaignId.description: Paid campaign ID from the provider (not a Nevent ObjectId). Use nevent_list_paid_campaigns to get valid campaignId values.

from.description: Start date for insights window (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to 7 days ago when omitted.

to.description: End date for insights window (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to today when omitted.

name: nevent_get_paid_campaign_insights
